aggregate.rationale: Governed: arbitrary collection aggregation can return unrestricted production document data.

aggregate-db.rationale: Governed: arbitrary database aggregation can access multiple collections and expose production data.

connect.rationale: Governed: changes the active deployment and credential-bound target; connection strings must remain inside the credential adapter.

create-collection.rationale: Governed: creates persistent database schema/storage state.

create-index.rationale: Governed: changes collection indexes and can materially affect availability and performance.

export.rationale: Governed: exports arbitrary query or aggregation results and can exfiltrate production data.

find.rationale: Governed: arbitrary filters and projections can return unrestricted production document data.

insert-many.rationale: Governed: performs bulk document insertion and can create substantial persistent state.

mongodb-logs.rationale: Governed: server logs can contain sensitive data, identifiers, topology, and operational details.

rename-collection.rationale: Governed: renames a collection and changes application-visible database structure.

update-many.rationale: Governed: performs bulk document updates against an arbitrary filter.
